scope: Read every nonretail paragraph and its own-date cited headline metadata; manually checked facts, companies, preview versus outcome, release timing, numerical direction and timeframe; checked all quoted market figures against own card and ran verifier. Retail keys excluded.

findings.issue: No major or fatal factual, company-identity, direction, numerical or release-timing error found after reading all nonretail paragraphs and cited metadata.
Currency symbols and several unlabelled index levels were made explicit; underlying figures and return windows were correct.

Tokyo core CPI release was available at 23:30 UTC on November 28 before the report cutoff. US cash-market and Treasury references correctly use November 27 while foreign cash-market and crypto references use November 28. Euro-zone inflation expectations are labelled as expectations; China home-price forecasts, tariff intentions, chip-rule relief, Fed technical-rate discussion and prospective transactions are not represented as completed outcomes.

No expired Allegro November 14 result or November 21 Polish housing outcome is cited. November 28 Guardian Reddit audience article would be eligible on November 29; no prohibited report-day outcome is inferred.
